title: Frame is not 4x6
text: Frame is not 4x6. This is not a 4x6 picture frame. I had a specific photo for it and had to cut the picture almost in half for it to fit. Maybe a 3x5. I'm  surprised nobody else has mentioned this. Also, usually with a little more money putting in the picture is made easier. This frame you almost have to break it to open it up. Then I saw it was made in China.  That answered most of my questions. I will not be buying any other arthur court products.
